errors.text_span: 该饼图显示了语料库大类标注结果的分布情况。图表中总共有八个切片，每个切片代表一个类别。这些类别分别是：A：诊断，占比9%；B：治疗，占比25.3%；C：常识，占比20.7%；D：健康生活方式，占比27.8%；E：流行病学，占比10.1%；F：其他，占比7.1%；D1：饮食，占比26.6%；D2：锻炼，占比0.6%；D3：减肥，占比0.1%；D0：其他， 占比 0.5%。
errors.evidence: The figure contains two related pie charts: a main chart with 6 slices and a sub-chart that breaks down one of the main slices into 4 smaller slices. The description incorrectly treats them as a single pie chart, listing all 10 slices as if they belong to the same whole. It also incorrectly states there are eight slices while listing ten.
The figure does not contain a legend. The labels for each slice are written directly on or next to the slices themselves.

errors.text_span: 并且切片似乎按照大小递减的顺序排列
errors.evidence: The slices in the main pie chart are not arranged in a strictly decreasing order of size. For example, moving counter-clockwise from the top right, the percentages are 7.1%, 10.1%, 20.7%, 25.3%, 9%, and 27.8%, which is not a sorted sequence.
